name: substance-painter
description: Control Substance 3D Painter layer stack and material creation via MCP

tools.name: sp_ping
tools.description: Check SP bridge connectivity — call before any operation sequence

tools.name: sp_get_layer_stack
tools.description: Return active texture set layer tree as JSON with ids, names, types

tools.name: sp_get_texture_sets
tools.description: Return all texture sets with their names and resolutions

tools.name: sp_get_layer_properties
tools.description: Return all properties of a specific layer by id

tools.name: sp_add_fill_layer
tools.description: Add a new Fill Layer to the active texture set

tools.name: sp_set_layer_property
tools.description: Modify a layer property (opacity, visible, name, blend_mode)

tools.name: sp_apply_smart_material
tools.description: Apply a Smart Material from the Shelf to a layer

tools.name: sp_add_smart_mask
tools.description: Add a procedural Smart Mask to a layer

tools.name: sp_list_shelf_materials
tools.description: List available Smart Materials in the Shelf

tools.name: sp_list_materials
tools.description: List available regular materials (SUBSTANCE type)

tools.name: sp_apply_material
tools.description: Apply a regular (non-Smart) material to a layer

tools.name: sp_set_iray_params
tools.description: Set Iray render parameters (max_samples, max_time, width, height)

tools.name: sp_start_iray_render
tools.description: Start Iray render asynchronously (starts after 500ms delay)

tools.name: sp_check_iray_render
tools.description: Check Iray render progress — returns iterations and elapsed time

tools.name: sp_capture_viewport
tools.description: Capture current viewport as base64 PNG (quick or render mode)

tools.name: sp_export_textures
tools.description: Export textures with a given preset to output directory

tools.name: sp_run_python
tools.description: Run arbitrary Python in Painter main thread (escape hatch — use specific tools first)

tools.name: sp_delete_layer
tools.description: Delete a layer from the stack by id

tools.name: sp_add_group_layer
tools.description: Add an empty group/folder layer

tools.name: sp_add_paint_layer
tools.description: Add a new Paint Layer for hand-painting

tools.name: sp_undo
tools.description: Undo last operation via SP native undo stack

tools.name: sp_redo
tools.description: Redo last undone operation via SP native redo stack

tools.name: sp_set_layer_channel
tools.description: Set a channel value (roughness/metallic/height/basecolor/normal) on a layer

tools.name: sp_get_layer_channels
tools.description: Get all channel states (opacity, blend_mode, source) of a layer

tools.name: sp_duplicate_layer
tools.description: Duplicate a layer — new layer placed above original

tools.name: sp_move_layer
tools.description: Move a layer above or below another layer

tools.name: sp_group_layers
tools.description: Group multiple layers into a new folder

tools.name: sp_ungroup_layer
tools.description: Ungroup a folder, releasing its children to parent level

tools.name: sp_set_active_texture_set
tools.description: Switch the active texture set by name

tools.name: sp_set_texture_set_resolution
tools.description: Change the resolution of the active texture set

tools.name: sp_get_project_info
tools.description: Get project name, file path, is_open, is_busy status

tools.name: sp_save_project
tools.description: Save the current project (.spp file)

tools.name: sp_set_camera
tools.description: Set camera position, target, and FOV

tools.name: sp_frame_mesh
tools.description: Frame the mesh in the viewport (auto-fit distance)

tools.name: sp_set_environment
tools.description: Switch HDRI environment light preset (Studio, Sunrise, etc.)

tools.name: sp_begin_batch
tools.description: Begin a batch operation — all layer changes merged as single undo

tools.name: sp_end_batch
tools.description: End batch operation and commit as single undo step

tools.name: sp_bake_mesh_maps
tools.description: Bake mesh maps (AO, Curvature, Normal, etc.) via JS API

tools.name: sp_add_texture_set_channel
tools.description: Add a custom channel to a texture set via JS API

tools.name: sp_remove_texture_set_channel
tools.description: Remove a channel from a texture set via JS API

tools.name: sp_window_info
tools.description: Get SP window position, size, and screen coordinates

tools.name: sp_window_grab
tools.description: Screenshot SP window or a region of it as base64 PNG

tools.name: sp_window_focus
tools.description: Focus SP window and show red MCP control warning banner

tools.name: sp_cu_unlock
tools.description: Release Computer Use control — green banner → hide after 10s

tools.name: sp_cu_banner_text
tools.description: Update the CU banner text (e.g. for timeout warnings)

tools.name: sp_cu_warning
tools.description: Show yellow timeout warning banner — user should check SP

tools.name: sp_mouse_move
tools.description: Move mouse cursor (screen or window-relative coordinates)

tools.name: sp_mouse_click
tools.description: Click mouse at position (left/right/middle, single/double)

tools.name: sp_mouse_scroll
tools.description: Scroll mouse wheel (±120 = 1 notch)

tools.name: sp_mouse_drag
tools.description: Drag mouse from one position to another

tools.name: sp_key_send
tools.description: Send keyboard input (text, special keys, or key combos with modifiers)

tools.name: sp_shortcut
tools.description: Execute predefined SP shortcut (save, undo, frame_all, etc.)
